description: Ralph Raye brought the bill, reported the flag, and refused a sum he did not see.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Kept the stage empty, named the Mayor's count, and would not invent a fine.
name: John Heminges

description: Said the three pounds, and would not round them.
name: Will Kemp

description: Called the idleness obedience, refused Henslowe's book, and said a fortnight.
name: William Shakespeare
